answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47504 Country: Pakistan Title: Swimming in the month of Ramadan Question: Is swimming allowed in the month of Ramadan while fasting? Answer ID: 47504 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1265/1036/H=10/1434) It is lawful in itself provided water does not enter into mouth and nose and satr is not uncovered and it involves no other evil. However, it is better to avoid swimming in the state of fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
